review_dimensions.question: Does KMA become the single canonical Memory Authority, or are there parallel truth sources?
sub_checks: Is MemoryKernel the sole write path for committed memory?
Does KnowledgeService wrap MemoryKernel without introducing a parallel store?
Are bypass paths to SQLiteStore eliminated?
Is supersession detection correct (superseded_by preserves history, query excludes superseded)?
Are mission_scope, confidence, and relevance properly separated?
Is the idempotency_key pattern sound (same-key-same-content returns original, different-content raises conflict)?
Does receipt_id enforcement via EvidenceStore.get_envelope() close the receipt loop?

review_dimensions.question: Does Evidence remain the Execution Fact Layer (not Business Logic Storage)? Is the Evidence→Receipt→Verification chain intact?
sub_checks: Are the 5 new EvidenceStore API methods (get_by_id, get_by_idempotency_key, get_envelope, receipt_status, find_by_idempotency) architecturally sound?
Is receipt_status() the SINGLE authority for receipt judgment (no runtime self-judgment)?
Is the fail-closed pattern correct (corrupt → invalid, not missing)?
Does KMA_INVARIANT_09 (No Raw Store Access) hold across all changed files?
Is evidence append-only preserved (no update/delete API introduced)?
Is the idempotent evidence_id derivation (SHA256 of 'evidence:{key}') deterministic and safe?

review_dimensions.question: Does the consolidated CircuitBreaker enable future Capability→Provider→Adapter routing, or does it lock in current providers?
sub_checks: Is the CircuitBreaker consolidation correct (model_gateway.py duplicate removed, single shared instance)?
Does the shared _shared_breaker injection pattern prevent race conditions?
Is the ModelProvider Protocol sufficient for future provider adapters?
Is routing capability-based (tier/context) rather than hardcoded to specific providers?
Does the ProviderInfo dataclass support extension for new providers?
key_files: src/nexara_prime/model_gateway.py (ModelGateway — removed local CB, accepts injected breaker)

review_dimensions.question: Does governance (Policy, Approval, Evidence, State) remain isolated from business logic?
sub_checks: Are PolicyEngine, ApprovalEngine, MissionStateMachine untouched by KMA changes?
Is CapabilityRegistry consolidation to single instance architecturally sound (not a runtime risk)?
Is cli.py PROGRAM_STATE migration correct (no stale PROJECT_STATE references)?
Are all fail-closed patterns preserved (memory evidence-binding, receipt status, idempotency conflict)?
Does KMA_INVARIANT_04 hold (recall is read-only — no write side effects)?
Is the change controlled by implementation scope allowlist/denylist?

review_dimensions.question: Can KMA support a future Context Compiler (Memory Retrieval → Relevant Context → Mission Execution)?
sub_checks: Are KnowledgeObject, KnowledgeRelation, KnowledgeRecall, KnowledgeCommit models sufficient for a future graph-based context compiler?
Does ChiefBrainKernel.recall() provide a clean entry point for context retrieval?
Are metadata fields (confidence, provenance, mission_id, trace_id, source_evidence_id) sufficient for relevance ranking?
Is the 11-relation KnowledgeRelation type set complete for future graph traversal?
Does layer-aware recall (working/episodic/semantic/procedural) map cleanly to context compilation tiers?
Are superseded records properly excluded from default recall (canonical-only by default)?

kma_invariants_for_review.text: Single Canonical Authority — each domain object has exactly one canonical source of truth
Evidence is Append-Only — no modify/delete API
Memory Requires Evidence — committed records must have valid source_evidence_id
Recall is Read-Only — queries must not modify memory or evidence
Human Approval for Conflicts — propose()→approve→commit_candidate() flow
Idempotent Writes — same logical operation repeated returns same result
Machine Index is Derived — search index from canonical source, not parallel truth
Obsidian is Human Surface — docs/ cannot change runtime state
No Raw Store Access — evidence-type records must go through EvidenceStore public API
Single Receipt Judgment — only EvidenceStore.receipt_status() may determine receipt presence
Capability History Persistence — invocation outcomes persisted to SQLiteStore
KMA Runtime Types must implement JSON schemas exactly
